Executor decision: the echo goes through a diag-only `echo` intent (plan payload in, `echo` event out; refused diag_only outside diag), so AC9 did not move to M2.3a. Known divergence (Godot 4.7.2 bug): JSON.parse_string/String.to_float return 0.0 for |x| <= DBL_MIN, so 5e-324 and 2.2250738585072014e-308 cannot reach Godot; the sim receives them exactly (reply text asserted) and the test accepts exact-or-flushed; no game value is that small, so the 0x bit-string fallback is not adopted. Godot JSON.stringify prints -0.0 as '0.0' and std/json reads '-0' as +0 (ailang#1460): SimBridge.number writes '-0.0' and uses full_precision otherwise. GDScript literal bug: -0.0 parses as +0.0 and 9007199254740991.0 as ...990, so tests build floats from bit patterns. features.notes: Executed on branch sprint/m2.3b-autopilot with runtime/bin/ailang v0.50.0, relativity 0.4.0. Tests first: core_test/protocol_test red (missing Crossing/Residuals/arrivalResiduals, committed ship held position), then green. Autopilot in core.tick: Commitment gains el (proper time since commit, set exactly to the boundary on crossing); phase = package phaseAt(trip, el) (via sim/tripphase.ail index, ailang#1478 workaround); each piece runs to the phase end and is flown with kinematics.accelerate at +a, 0, -a; phase event {from,to,tau} per crossing (first piece also emits at_rest>boosting); at tauTotal residuals taken before the snap, then phi=0, position=target.pos (origin=target, x0=x), arrived event {residual_x,residual_t,residual_phi}; leftover dtau at rest; Committed->Arrived only here. Ledger per piece: boost/brake photonDriveEnergy(mEff,|dphi|) (brake's last dphi to the snapped 0), cruise mirrorDragPower(n,phiPeak,R)*piece*yr. Commit rebases the line of motion (origin=position, x0=x) even without a turn. AC5 PASS: checkVoyageBoundaries (0.01-yr stepped alpha Cen at 0.99c and at the cap, plus diag 1 g flip Gl 559: every tick end == motionAt(el) to 1e-9, crossing taus == tau0 + boundary to 1e-12, ticks ending exactly on each boundary == dBurn/phiPeak/d-dBurn/arrival); checkArrivalResidual (< 1e-9 max(1,d) at 0.99c, cap, flip; position == target bit for bit; leftover at rest; checkResidualsMeasured: offsets of 1e-6 ly / 2e-6 yr / phi 1e-7 are reported). alpha Cen 0.99c replay residuals: x 1.78e-15 ly, t 7.99e-15 yr, phi 4.84e-11. AC6 PASS: checkLedgerAtArrival (m_eff 3 kg at 0.99c and cap, m_eff 0.5/n 1 cm^-3 at 10 ly 0.9c: total, boost+brake and drag each to 1e-9 rel; frozen after arrival); checkMassClosed. Also checkWholeBoostTick (commit tick: committed + two phase events at tau0 and tau0+tauBurn exactly), checkStartEventOnce, checkArrivedThenReplan, checkArrivalOnWire (protocol). AC10 part PASS: make strict journeyVm VM == interpreter 4.491447784623953 vs closed form 4.491447784623963; voyageVm voyage-ok both. AC14 PASS: tests/replays/alpha_cen.ndjson (hello, new_game, plan, commit, 62 more 0.01 ticks, quit) last line has arrived; new make target journey-replay (VM == interpreter, 66 lines) in make test. M2.3a eval follow-ups: checkPlanFromMovedShip (d from a moved ship, then commit along the same heading and land), checkCommitMovingBoundary (|phi| = 1e-9 refused, 9.999999e-10 accepted), NaN guard phi == phi in core range check + checkNaNCruise, design doc M2.3 exhaustiveness wording and Planned shape amended. make test green: 76 ailang tests, bridge 0 failures, parity 602/17/13, offaxis-v11-equiv, strict all. Mutations: 18 applied, 17 killed (incl. no tick splitting, boundary split a tick late, residuals after snap / zero, drag during boost, phase tau at tick end, ledger not closed at arrival, no position/phi snap, leftover dropped, never Arrived, NaN guard, moving >=, d ignoring position, commit without rebase, wrong coast boundary (hangs), 1 kg m_eff); 1 equivalent on tested values (el = el + piece instead of b: exact in floating point there). Updated M2.3a tests for the flying ship: checkCommittedRefusesAll / plAllRefused compare against the autopilot-only tick; checkCommitTurns at dtau 0; checkCommitDropsThrust == commit-only tick; checkCommittedView also frozen after arrival. Deviations: Event gains phase/arrived options (+residual_phi); Commitment gains el; sim/tripphase.ail; commit always rebases; journey-replay make target. AILANG: filed ailang#1478 (aliased constructor import never matches; unknown constructor in a pattern is not an error). LOC: code core.ail +~120, protocol.ail +~20, tripphase.ail 11, Makefile +18; tests core_test +~250, protocol_test +~30; replay 67 lines.
